review_type: Independent second-assistant blind semantic review; not human annotation
overall_verdict: Accept all recorded gold outcomes. No material semantic correction is required.
difficulty_assessment: The stated 9/20/11 difficulty distribution is intact. Labels are defensible as design categories: explicit single-action cases are easy, extra field or action-boundary decisions are generally medium, and contextual correction, distractor rejection, or arithmetic with scoped bases are generally hard. No empirical difficulty claim can be established by this blind semantic review alone.
validation: All 40 tasks pass Draft 2020-12 task-schema validation, canonical embedded-tool equality, gold tool-argument validation, and clarification target/required-field checks. IDs are unique, and review-draft gold, family, and difficulty fields match the holdout.
clarification_question_omission: Accepted as intentional canonical gold representation; question wording is not a required gold field.
